title: Damascus pattern-welded steel
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of etched Damascus (pattern-welded) steel: bright and dark layers in random, ladder, raindrop or chevron patterns, with varying layer thickness, etch relief and grinding lines, and fine layers kept free of moire. Use for knife blades, swords, rings and props.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python damascus_steel.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: layers
parameters.meaning: Layer pairs down the tile (bright and dark layer together).

parameters.name: distortion
parameters.meaning: How far the forging displaces the layers, in layer pairs.

parameters.name: features
parameters.meaning: Ladder rungs, raindrop dimples or chevrons across the tile.

parameters.name: randomness
parameters.meaning: Share of random folding added to the ladder, raindrop and chevron patterns.

parameters.name: thickness_variation
parameters.meaning: How much the bright layers thicken and thin across the blade.

parameters.name: etch
parameters.meaning: Etch depth: contrast and relief between the layer kinds.

parameters.name: grind_lines
parameters.meaning: Fine grinding lines along the blade (across the tile).

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Random-pattern Damascus with folded contours, medium etch.

presets.name: ladder
presets.description: Ladder pattern: regular rungs where grooves were cut across the billet.

presets.name: raindrop
presets.description: Raindrop pattern: concentric rings around drilled dimples.

presets.name: chevron
presets.description: Chevron pattern from a restacked billet, light satin etch.

presets.name: coffee_etch
presets.description: Deep coffee etch: near-black layers and bright nickel lines, fine stack.

limits: The pattern is a contour model of a distorted layer stack, not a forging simulation; ladder, raindrop and chevron are idealized versions of the smith's grooves, dimples and restacking. Layers finer than about two pixels fade to their average tone instead of drawing, so very fine stacks need a large texture. The etch relief is shallow and best carried by the normal map. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Layer phase as a whole number of layer pairs plus a periodic displacement
Domain-warped fractional Brownian motion for random folding
Gaussian grooves, summed Gaussian dimples and a triangle wave for ladder, raindrop and chevron
Band contrast faded by the analytic phase gradient against the pixel size
Mean share of a thresholded cosine for unresolved layers
